newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber slips on lower Thai offer price.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber slips on lower Thai offer price.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Tuesday, pressured by lower Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's rebound against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.1 yen to 3.2 yen per kg lower.
Most-active benchmark August was off 2.3 yen at 153.7 yen.
Prices edged down for most of the day on sporadic selling.
"Slack physical demand in rubber producing countries caused a slip in Thai rubber offer prices to Japan," one trader said.
Thai rubber offer prices to Japan was quoted at around $1.24 per kg on Tuesday, against about $1.26 last Friday.
